data.name: DataStore SQL (Run SQL on the DataStore)
data.description:
Execute SQL SELECT queries across DataStore resources using PostgreSQL SQL. Supports joins across resources. There is a server-enforced timeout and a maximum result row limit (default 32000). This action may be disabled via ckan.datastore.sqlsearch.enabled configuration.
Documentation: https://docs.ckan.org/en/2.9/maintaining/datastore.html
Quick Start:
- POST { "sql": "SELECT * FROM \"{{resourceId}}\" LIMIT 10" } to /api/3/action/datastore_search_sql.
- Include Authorization header when querying private resources.
Parameters:
- sql (required): Single SQL SELECT statement. Use double quotes for UPPERCASE CSV headers.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 401 Unauthorized: Missing Authorization for private resources.
- 400 Bad Request: Invalid SQL or disabled sqlsearch on server.
- Truncated results if query returns more than site max (check records_truncated flag).
Edge Cases:
- Action may be disabled globally (ckan.datastore.sqlsearch.enabled=false).
- Results truncated when exceeding ckan.datastore.search.rows_max (defaults to 32000).
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Enforced timeout and maximum rows to protect against long-running queries.
data.evaluateGuide:
Executes a read-only SQL SELECT against a Toronto Open Data datastore and returns matching rows. Use it for joins, filtering, aggregation, or selecting specific columns.
Use for: query datastore rows, join resources, aggregate data, filter records
Not supported: inserts or updates, resource creation, dataset administration

data.name: Datastore SQL Query (datastore_search_sql)
data.description:
Execute SQL-style queries against a datastore-backed resource. Useful for complex filtering, aggregation or selecting specific columns.
Documentation: https://open.toronto.ca/dataset/street-tree-data/
Quick Start:
- Make a GET request with a URL-encoded SQL statement in the sql parameter.
- Example: SELECT * FROM "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee" LIMIT 5
Parameters Explained:
- sql (required): a SQL string addressing the datastore table (use the resource id as the table name). Example: SELECT * FROM "{{resourceId}}" LIMIT 10
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 400 Bad Request: malformed SQL or forbidden operations — validate SQL syntax.
- 403 Forbidden: attempt to run disallowed operations (rare for public read).
Edge Cases:
- SQL must reference the resource table name (usually the resource id). Quoting the table name is often required.
- Long-running SQL may time out; prefer small result sets.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- No public per-endpoint rate limits documented; use responsibly.

data.name: DataStore: SQL Query (datastore_search_sql)
data.description:
Run a SQL SELECT statement against a DataStore resource. Useful for complex queries not expressible with the standard search parameters.
Documentation: https://www.opendata.nhs.scot/ne/api/1/util/snippet/api_info.html
Quick Start:
- Provide a URL-encoded sql parameter to the endpoint (GET) or send a JSON body with the sql string (POST). Example: ?sql=SELECT * from "{{resourceId}}" WHERE title LIKE 'jones'.
- Note: SQL execution may be restricted for security; some CKAN instances disable this endpoint or restrict allowed SQL functions.
Parameters Explained:
- sql (required): A single SQL SELECT statement to execute (string). The table name is the resource_id for the DataStore resource.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 400 Bad Request: Malformed SQL or unsupported SQL features. Ensure you submit a valid SELECT statement.
- 403 Forbidden: SQL execution disabled for the instance or access denied for private resources.
- 500 Internal Server Error: Query caused a server error (e.g., heavy aggregation on very large tables) — simplify the query or limit returned rows.
Edge Cases:
- The instance may restrict functions or statements for security. Do not rely on advanced DB functions unless documented as allowed by the CKAN instance.
- Large SQL queries may time out or be limited by configured SQL row limits.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- SQL queries can be more expensive than parameterised searches; use them sparingly and consider pagination or limiting returned rows.

data.name: DataStore: SQL Query (datastore_search_sql)
data.description:
Execute a SQL SELECT query against the DataStore (read-only SQL execution where enabled).
Documentation: https://www.opendata.nhs.scot/en/api/3/action/datastoresearchsql
Quick Start:
- Provide a URL-encoded SQL SELECT statement in the sql query parameter (GET) or in the JSON body (POST). Example: ?sql=SELECT * from "{{resourceId}}" WHERE name LIKE 'jones' LIMIT 5.
- Note: the endpoint is only available when the DataStore is backed by PostgreSQL and SQL execution is enabled by the site; some installations disable SQL access for security.
Parameters Explained:
- sql (required): a single SQL SELECT statement. Only SELECT queries are allowed; other statements are rejected.
- resource_id (optional): not required if SQL references the table; can be used by clients to indicate the target resource.
- limit, offset (optional): may be used in SQL or ignored if server-side limits apply.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 400 Bad Request / 409 Conflict: malformed SQL or non-SELECT statement — restrict to single SELECT statements.
- 403 Forbidden: SQL execution disabled on this site for security reasons.
- 500 Internal Server Error: SQL timed out or server error — simplify query or reduce complexity.
Edge Cases:
- Results may return numeric values as strings for some column types depending on DB drivers.
- SQL execution may have enforced timeouts and limited capabilities (no writes, limited functions).
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- SQL queries may be subject to stricter limits and timeouts than datastore_search to prevent abuse.

data.name: DataStore SQL Query (datastore_search_sql)
data.description:
Execute a SQL SELECT statement against the DataStore (if SQL search is enabled on the CKAN instance).
Documentation: https://www.opendata.nhs.scot/en/api/3/action/datastoresearchsql (primary), additional docs: https://www.opendata.nhs.scot/en/api/1/util/snippet/apiinfo.html?resourceid=e44eb789-b8e0-41d9-a264-eba18b2d2473 and CKAN DataStore docs: https://docs.ckan.org/en/2.10/maintaining/datastore.html
Quick Start:
- SQL search must be enabled on the CKAN site (ckan.datastore.sqlsearch.enabled).
- Call via GET (example) or POST with a sql parameter.
- Example GET:
  - {{baseUrl}}/en/api/3/action/datastoresearchsql?sql=SELECT+*+FROM+"{{resourceId}}"+LIMIT+5
Parameters Explained:
- sql (required): a single SQL SELECT statement string. The table name is the DataStore resource id (or alias). Example: SELECT * FROM "e44eb789-b8e0-41d9-a264-eba18b2d2473" WHERE title LIKE 'jones'.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 400 Bad Request: malformed SQL or unsupported SQL syntax. Validate SQL statement.
- 409 Conflict or 500 Internal Server Error: server rejects or times out long-running SQL. Keep queries simple and use LIMIT.
- 403 Forbidden / 401 Unauthorized: SQL query touches private resources and caller lacks authorization.
- Not Implemented / disabled: the action may be disabled on the server (ckan.datastore.sqlsearch.enabled=false).
Edge Cases:
- SQL engine is PostgreSQL; some SQL functions may be restricted by configuration (site may whitelist functions).
- Results capped by server configuration (ckan.datastore.search.rows_max); the site may enforce a hard limit (e.g., 32000).
- Column names that were in the source CSV in ALL UPPERCASE may need double quotes in SQL.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Server-enforced timeouts and row limits apply; avoid large unbounded SELECTs.

data.name: DataStore - SQL Query (datastore_search_sql)
data.description:
Execute SQL queries against the DataStore. Allows flexible SQL SELECT statements (joins across resources supported when enabled).
Documentation: https://www.opendata.nhs.scot/km/api/1/util/snippet/api_info.html
Quick Start:
- HTTP GET {{baseUrl}}/km/api/3/action/datastoresearchsql?sql={{sql}}
- sql must be a single SQL SELECT statement. Example from the snippet page: SELECT * from "{{resourceId}}" WHERE title LIKE 'jones'
Parameters Explained:
- sql (required): A single SQL SELECT statement. Must reference resource tables by resource id (table name).
Common Errors & Fixes:
- success: false with an error object: check SQL syntax and permissions (some sites disable SQL search).
- records_truncated=true: results limited by server configuration (32000 by default).
Edge Cases:
- SQL search may be disabled on the site (ckan.datastore.sqlsearch.enabled = false).
- Some SQL engines return numeric columns as strings; verify types when parsing results.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- SQL queries have enforced timeouts and row limits (default 32000). Queries requiring access to private resources need appropriate authorization.

data.name: DataStore - SQL Query (datastore_search_sql)
data.description:
Execute SQL SELECT statements against the DataStore (joins across resources supported where allowed).
Documentation: https://www.opendata.nhs.scot/en/api/1/util/snippet/apiinfo.html?resourceid=e44eb789-b8e0-41d9-a264-eba18b2d2473 and https://docs.ckan.org/en/2.11/maintaining/datastore.html#ckanext.datastore.logic.action.datastoresearchsql
Quick Start:
- POST JSON to {{baseUrl}}/en/api/3/action/datastoresearchsql with sql containing a single SELECT statement.
- Note: SQL search may be disabled site-wide (ckan.datastore.sqlsearch.enabled). Ensure you have permission to query all referenced resources.
- Result set size limited (default max ~32000 rows; configurable via site settings).
Parameters Explained:
- sql (required): a single SQL SELECT statement using PostgreSQL semantics; quoting may be required for uppercase column names.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 400 Bad Request: malformed SQL or more than one statement provided — send a single SELECT only.
- 403 Forbidden / success:false: access denied when user lacks permissions to one or more resources referenced in the query — ensure appropriate Authorization or query only public resources.
- 500 Internal Server Error: complex queries exceeding timeout or DB limits — simplify query or increase site timeouts (sysadmin).
Edge Cases:
- Uppercase CSV-derived column headers must be double-quoted in SQL statements.
- There is an enforced timeout on SQL queries to prevent DoS; very large/complex queries may be terminated.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Query result cap (typically 32000 rows) and site-configured timeouts apply. SQL queries are allowed only when enabled by site configuration.

data.name: Datastore SQL Query (datastore_search_sql)
data.description:
Run a SQL query against a DataStore resource (returns JSON). Useful for complex queries not expressible via datastore_search parameters.
Documentation: https://www.opendata.nhs.scot/faIR/api/1/util/snippet/apiinfo.html
Quick Start:
- Minimum: GET {{baseUrl}}/faIR/api/3/action/datastoresearch_sql?sql={{sql}}
- Ensure the SQL references the DataStore table name (which is the resource id) in double quotes, e.g. SELECT * from "{{resourceId}}".
Parameters Explained:
- sql (required): HTSQL/SQL statement to run against the DataStore. Must be URL-encoded when used in a query string.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 400 Bad Request: Malformed or unsafe SQL — ensure proper quoting and syntax.
- 200 OK with success: false: CKAN-level SQL error returned in error object.
Edge Cases:
- SQL may be restricted by the CKAN installation (certain functions or constructs may not be allowed).
- Large or expensive queries may time out; prefer server-side pagination or filters.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- The snippet page does not list portal-specific rate limits. Use responsibly.

data.name: DataStore - Query via SQL (datastore_search_sql)
data.description:
Run a SQL SELECT query against a DataStore resource.
Documentation: https://www.opendata.nhs.scot/ro/api/1/util/snippet/api_info.html
Quick Start:
- Use GET with a url-encoded sql parameter, or POST with JSON containing sql.
- Example: GET {{baseUrl}}/ro/api/3/action/datastore_search_sql?sql={{sql}} where sql = SELECT * from "{{resourceId}}" LIMIT 5.
Parameters Explained:
- sql (required): A single SQL SELECT statement. Use the resource id (table name) double-quoted in SQL, e.g. SELECT * FROM "e44eb..." WHERE title LIKE 'jones'.
- resource_id (optional in some setups): resource id to reference, but typically the resource id is used as the SQL table name.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 400 Bad Request: Malformed SQL or forbidden statements (only SELECT allowed).
- 403 Forbidden: SQL search disabled on this CKAN installation or you lack permissions for private data.
- 500 Internal Server Error: SQL execution error (check syntax or permissions).
Edge Cases:
- The DataStore SQL endpoint may be disabled on some instances (site config option). Join across multiple resources is supported only if the tables exist and permissions allow.
- Beware SQL injection; only trusted SQL should be executed.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Very large SQL queries may be limited by site configuration; prefer limits and filters.
